title: Aflac Incorporated Announces Leadership Promotions for Aflac Japan and Aflac U.S.
summary: Aflac Incorporated announced today that as part of its long-term succession planning, subsidiaries Aflac Life Insurance Japan Ltd. (Aflac Japan) and Aflac U.S. will implement planned leadership...
body_markdown:
COLUMBUS, Ga.


, Nov. 2, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Aflac Incorporated announced today that as part of its long-term succession planning, subsidiaries Aflac Life Insurance Japan Ltd. (Aflac Japan) and Aflac U.S. will implement planned leadership transitions effective January 1, 2027.


Deputy President of Aflac Japan Shinsuke Morimoto will be promoted to President of Aflac Japan and Representative Director, responsible for Aflac Japan's overall business execution. In addition to his expanded role at Aflac Japan, Morimoto will join the Aflac Holdings LLC Board of Managers, which oversees Aflac Japan as an insurance holding company licensed under Japan law.


Deputy President of Aflac U.S. Frederic J. Simard will be promoted to President of Aflac U.S., responsible for strategy, distribution and operations.


Masatoshi Koide (currently President of Aflac Japan, Representative Director) will assume the role of Chairman of Aflac Japan and Representative Director. In this role, he will lead Aflac Japan's Board of Directors in conducting decision-making on important matters related to Aflac Japan, as well as oversight of its business operations. He will continue to serve on the Aflac Holdings LLC Board of Managers. Charles D. Lake II (currently Chairman of Aflac Japan and Representative Director) will become Executive Advisor of Aflac Japan and assume the role of Chairman of Aflac International, representing Aflac externally on international affairs. He will continue to serve on the Aflac Holdings LLC Board of Managers.


Regarding the announcements, Aflac Incorporated Chairman and CEO Daniel P. Amos said: "These leadership announcements are the result of the long-term and deliberate succession planning process and coordination overseen by Aflac Incorporated's Board of Directors to ensure we have the right people in the right places at the right time. President of Aflac Incorporated Virgil Miller and I agree that the strength of our leadership bench is also a testament to the strong foundation created by Charles Lake and Masatoshi Koide, whose leadership has had a tremendous positive impact on Aflac Japan and across the Aflac organization."


Miller added: "Shinsuke Morimoto has been with the Company for nearly four decades in positions of leadership across key areas, from Claims and Sales to Corporate Planning and Strategy. He has played a vital role in developing Aflac Japan's mid-term strategy and transforming Aflac Japan's marketing and sales organization and human capital management system. I am excited about the results Shinsuke has delivered and confident that his deep understanding of our business, culture and strategy will help lead Aflac Japan successfully into the future."


Miller went on to say: "Fred Simard brought more than 30 years of insurance experience when he joined Aflac U.S. in 2023 as senior vice president and chief financial officer. He was then promoted to executive vice president and chief operating officer of Aflac U.S. in 2025 and to deputy president of Aflac U.S. in early 2026. The three-plus decades of industry experience he has gathered across a broad range of business and financial areas provide the mix of leadership, discipline and expertise we need. I look forward to his continued contributions as we look ahead to Aflac U.S."


**ABOUT AFLAC INCORPORATED** Aflac Incorporated (NYSE: AFL), a Fortune 500 company, has helped provide financial protection and peace of mind for more than seven decades to millions of policyholders and customers through its subsidiaries in the U.S. and Japan. In the U.S., Aflac is the No. 1 provider of supplemental health insurance products.1 In Japan, Aflac Life Insurance Japan is the leading provider of cancer and medical insurance in terms of policies in force.2 The company takes pride in being there for its policyholders when they need us most, as well as being included in the World's Most Ethical Companies by Ethisphere for 20 consecutive years (2026) and Fortune's World's Most Admired Companies for 25 years (2026). In addition, the company became a signatory of the Principles for Responsible Investment (PRI) in 2021.
